shell_commands: timeout 300 npm test -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t "wraps a string rejection" 2>&1
timeout 300 npm test -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t "wraps a string rejection" 2>&1 | tail -50
timeout 300 npm test -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t "wraps a string rejection" 2>&1 | tail -40

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(orchestrator): call onError for non-Error rejections

Wrap string and non-Error rejections in an Error instance so the onError
hook always fires, while preserving the original rejection for the caller.
Non-Error values are wrapped with the original stored as the cause, so
hooks typed against Error still compile and callers receive the rejection
unchanged.

Fixes #95
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main
timeout 300 npm test -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "Test Suites|Tests:" | head -5
